tasks.verified: The patient's verbatim is the authority on ordinals and weekday anaphors: an ordinal day-of-month spoken by the patient but dropped by extraction is re-attached, and 'that <weekday>' anchors to the context week, proven at the handler seam with the cumulative suite grown past 123 tests.
tasks.spec:
ROLE: fix worker for the Mott booking gateway, lane 55 (verbatim date authority - ordinals and weekday anaphors). Work entirely inside your CWD; never modify anything outside it; no network, no git, no MCP/Apps/skills, no deploys, do not load skills.

CONTEXT - two measured defects from a live regression replay (envelope captures, extraction variables shown):
(a) After being offered Wednesday 08/26, the patient corrected 'No Thursday the 27'. The LLM extractor wrote preference_from='thursday next week' - it DROPPED the ordinal 'the 27' and INVENTED 'next week'. The gateway obeyed and offered Thursday 08/13. The correct day was Thursday 08/27 (the gateway's own specificity rule - explicit date beats weekday - already handles 'thursday the 27' when it receives it; the words never arrived).
(b) After the same Wednesday 08/26 offer, the patient asked 'How late can I come in that Thursday'. Extraction wrote preference_from='thursday' - the anaphor 'that' was dropped, so the day lost its anchor to the offered week. Lane 52's resolve_anaphoric_week covers verbatim 'that week'/'same week' phrases but NOT the 'that <weekday>' form.
The design rule of this system: extraction nondeterminism must never be load-bearing; the gateway receives user_text, user_verbatim and context_date (the currently offered slot, e.g. '08/26/2026 10:30 am') on every availability request and must treat the patient's verbatim as the authority.

SOURCE - copy /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workR25/gw-meridiem-authority-fix/fixed-bland_gateway.py (byte-identical to the deployed lane-54 gateway) into your CWD as fixed-bland_gateway.py and edit that copy. Copy the cumulative test tree /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workR25/gw-meridiem-authority-fix/gwtest into ./gwtest and extend it; every existing test must still pass.

FIX 1 - VERBATIM ORDINAL AUTHORITY, at the handler-level from-resolution seam:
1. TRIGGER (all required): (a) user_verbatim or user_text contains an explicit day-of-month ordinal - numeric ('the 27', 'the 27th', 'on the 3rd') or spelled ('the twenty-seventh', already recognized by lane 53); (b) the from-text contains NO day-of-month number or ordinal (extraction dropped it) - qualifiers like 'next week' or a bare weekday count as lacking it.
2. ACTION: resolve using the verbatim's ordinal through the gateway's EXISTING ordinal/specificity path (nearest future occurrence of that day-of-month; if the from-text also names a weekday, the explicit ordinal date wins per the standing specificity rule - do not require the weekday to match).
3. NON-TRIGGERS (unchanged): from-text already carries the ordinal or any explicit date; verbatim has no ordinal; the verbatim ordinal is part of a clock time ('at 4:27') - guard against that.

FIX 2 - THAT-WEEKDAY ANAPHOR: extend the lane-52 anaphoric trigger so verbatim forms 'that <weekday>', '<weekday> that week', 'on that <weekday>' (case-insensitive, full weekday names) ALSO anchor the named weekday to the Monday-Sunday week containing context_date, with the same past-day guard and non-triggers as lane 52. FIX 1 outranks FIX 2 when both could apply (an explicit ordinal beats an anaphor).

DELIVERABLES in CWD:
- fixed-bland_gateway.py (full edited file)
- proof_verbatim_date.py - executable proof at the handler-level seam. Derive dates from datetime.date.today(): ctx = today + 21 days formatted like a slot start ('%m/%d/%Y 10:30 am'); thu = the Thursday of ctx's Monday-Sunday week; o27 = nearest future 27th. Print exactly:
  CASE=ordinal-dropped FROM=<o27 iso> (from='thursday next week', verbatim='No Thursday the 27', context=ctx)
  CASE=ordinal-present-unchanged FROM=<o27 iso> (from='thursday the 27', verbatim='No Thursday the 27', context=ctx)
  CASE=that-weekday FROM=<thu iso> (from='thursday', verbatim='How late can I come in that Thursday', context=ctx)
  CASE=bare-weekday-no-anaphor FROM=<the next Thursday from today, iso> (from='thursday', verbatim='how about thursday?', context=ctx - no override)
  CASE=clock-not-ordinal FROM=<the next Thursday from today, iso> (from='thursday', verbatim='thursday at 4:27 pm?', context='' - the 27 in a clock time must not trigger)
  CASE=ordinal-beats-anaphor FROM=<o27 iso> (from='thursday', verbatim='that Thursday, the 27th', context=ctx)
- ./gwtest extended with at least 7 new tests covering both fixes, the precedence rule, the clock-time guard, and the no-anaphor control.
- DEBUG-GW55.md - what changed, where, exact trigger regexes, known limitations.

HARD RULES: do not weaken, remove or skip any existing test; keep all lane-51/52/53/54 behavior intact (meridiem inference, resolve_anaphoric_week, vocab, verbatim meridiem authority, closed_day); keep the file runnable as the single gateway module it is; no placeholder code.
tasks.check: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 ./proof_verbatim_date.py > proof.out 2>&1 || { echo 'FAIL: proof crashed'; tail -8 proof.out; exit 1; }; o27=$(python3 -c "import datetime as d;t=d.date.today();print(t.replace(day=27).isoformat() if t.day<27 else (t.replace(day=1)+d.timedelta(days=32)).replace(day=27).isoformat())"); thu=$(python3 -c "import datetime as d;t=d.date.today();c=t+d.timedelta(days=21);m=c-d.timedelta(days=c.weekday());print((m+d.timedelta(days=3)).isoformat())"); nthu=$(python3 -c "import datetime as d;t=d.date.today();print((t+d.timedelta(days=((3-t.weekday())%7 or 7))).isoformat())"); for c in "CASE=ordinal-dropped FROM=$o27" "CASE=ordinal-present-unchanged FROM=$o27" "CASE=that-weekday FROM=$thu" "CASE=bare-weekday-no-anaphor FROM=$nthu" "CASE=clock-not-ordinal FROM=$nthu" "CASE=ordinal-beats-anaphor FROM=$o27"; do grep -q "$c" proof.out || { echo "FAIL: missing $c"; cat proof.out; exit 1; }; done; grep -q 'resolve_anaphoric_week' fixed-bland_gateway.py && grep -q 'closed_day' fixed-bland_gateway.py || { echo 'FAIL: prior lane behavior lost'; exit 1; }; cd gwtest && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest -q > ../pytest.out 2>&1; rc=$?; cd ..; summary=$(tail -1 pytest.out); [ $rc -eq 0 ] || { echo "FAIL: suite red: $summary"; tail -10 pytest.out; exit 1; }; n=$(echo "$summary" | grep -oE '^[0-9]+'); [ "$n" -ge 123 ] || { echo "FAIL: only $n tests, floor is 123 (116 cumulative + 7 new)"; exit 1; }; echo "PASS: verbatim date authority proven - $summary"
